description: This file defines a 'WatchConnectivityReceiver' class that manages communication between an iOS app and watchOS extension via the WatchConnectivity framework. It handles sending messages, transferring user info, and receiving notifications from the WatchConnectivity session. It also defines related data structures for messaging results and drafts.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: Manages the watch connectivity session, handles message sending, and processes incoming messages and application context updates.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession and sets self as delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures that the session is activated, with retries.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch, either immediately if reachable or via transfer.
